meta.name: Simpsons Tall Tales
meta.description: When Homer refuses to pay a five dollar airport tax to fly to Delaware, the family is forced to ride in a livestock car of a train instead. There they meet a singing hobo who tells three tall tales:  Homer as Paul Bunyan.  Lisa as Connie Appleseed, a parody of Johnny Appleseed.
